# Hunyuan3D AI

> > AI-powered 3D model generation platform using Hunyuan3D-2 technology to convert images and text into production-ready 3D assets with PBR textures in OBJ, GLB, and VRM formats.

Hunyuan3D AI provides free tools powered by Tencent's Hunyuan3D technology for creating 3D models from 2D images or text prompts. The platform supports specialized workflows for Roblox UGC, VRChat avatars, architectural rendering, and integration with Blender and ComfyUI.

## Key Topics

- Hunyuan3D-2 AI technology
- 2D to 3D conversion
- OBJ and GLB file formats
- PBR texture generation
- Blender integration
- Roblox UGC creation
- VRChat and VRM avatars
- Architecture 3D rendering
- ComfyUI workflow
- Hunyuan3D Studio
- Free AI 3D tools
- Text-to-3D generation
- Image-to-3D conversion
- 3D character creation
- Generative AI for 3D modeling

## Core AI 3D Tools

- [Free AI 3D Tools](https://hunyuan3dai.com/tools/): Main tools hub for Hunyuan3D-2 AI-powered 3D model generation platform
- [Free PNG to 3D Model Converter](https://hunyuan3dai.com/tools/convert-png-to-3d-model-free/): Convert PNG/JPG images to 3D models using Hunyuan3D-2 AI technology
- [Free Roblox 3D Item Maker AI](https://hunyuan3dai.com/tools/roblox-3d-item-maker/): AI tool for creating Roblox UGC accessories and items from text or images
- [Free Architecture 3D Render AI](https://hunyuan3dai.com/tools/architecture-3d-render-ai/): Convert architectural plans and sketches to 3D building models with AI

- [Posts](https://hunyuan3dai.com/posts/): Blog posts covering Hunyuan3D updates, tutorials, and 3D generation guides
